## Summary

What changes, and why.

## Tests run

The commands you ran, for example `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm check:dist`.

## Checklist

- [ ] New behaviour has tests.
- [ ] `dist/` is rebuilt and committed with the source.
- [ ] No tool approves, assigns, changes, pays, mails or deletes.
- [ ] The change holds no keys or large binaries.
